questions: When the price of something goes up or down, do you want to change it on the list? If so, should the old price be kept so you can look back at it?
Do you sell the same thing in different sizes or amounts at different prices, for example one tin versus a full carton, or a cup of rice versus a full bag?
When you look up an item, will you type its full name exactly, or should typing part of the name (like "milo") show every matching item?
answers: Yes, prices change all the time, especially sugar, rice and oil. I need to change the price of an item.
